title: Perfect tour with a knowledgeable and friendly tour guide
text:
The tour gives you the right context to explore Seville.  So I highly recommend to go for this tour early when you visit Seville.

Lorena is surely knows Seville inside out. She knows all the important places and the story behind.  She will give you hard to find information and recommendations that we find absolutely useful.
author: Roby_M

title: The Best English speaking Guide in Sevilla!
text: Lorena was a very friendly and professional guide,would recommend to everybody.She told us many interesting facts about Sevilla,explained,answered our questions.She is fluent in English so easy to understand and communicate.We will definitely contact her when we will be back in Spain.Thank you Lorena.
author: Audronita

title: Fantastic Tour Guide
text: Lorena is a fantastic Tour Guide. Her knowledge of Seville and its history was truly amazing! She was the best combination of knowledgable with a sense of humour! She was willing to answer questions and provide additional facts that we would never have found in a normal guide book.
author: Go20677365382

title: Absolutely recommended
text:
I was lucky enough to take a guided tour with Lorena and I will repeat again without any doubt. Lorena has a great knowledge of the city and conveys passion for making us all know details and curiosities of what she teaches. Also, she is very friendly and gets time to fly by, wishing to do more routes again with her.

In addition, he gave us recommendations of bars and places to eat that we could enjoy during the rest of the day. A complete and highly recommended experience
author: 507pedrob

title: An Unforgettable Sevilla Experience with an Amazing Guide!
text: I recently had the pleasure of exploring Sevilla with the guidance of an incredible tour guide. Highly recommend this guide to anyone visiting Sevilla—you won’t regret it! 🌟
author: joyd452

title: Amazing experience doing the tour with Lorraine
text: I have been on a tourist route with Lorraine several times and they have been amazing experiences. In the first of them we visited the church of the French and in the second, the cathedral of Seville and the royal alcazares. I highlight Lorraine's good explanations of the monuments, always providing many details and curious data. She is very attentive to the group, always watching that no one is left behind. She is a very friendly and friendly guide. After finishing the route, he offered recommendations for places to eat in Seville and tips on the city. We will definitely do a route with Lorra
author: angelaalaez
